conservativeDeadline: Inputs must be timestamped before 00:00 UTC on seriesStartDate because historical tip times are not retained.

laggedRotations.rule: Do not infer a pre-series rotation from games played after the deadline. Only named, sourced, lagged observations totaling 240 minutes are eligible.

exact240Hypothesis.contractLevel: One team-level projected rotation for one regulation game; never a ten-game minute aggregate.

laggedRotations.diagnosis: Genuine source-coverage failure: the repository contains no timestamped player-level pre-series game-log observations. No contract clause eliminated a candidate.

externalBenchmarks.rule: Only timestamped public probabilities or explicitly no-vig two-sided series prices are eligible. Closing prices observed after the deadline are excluded.
